title: Evaluating Moral Beliefs across LLMs through a Pluralistic Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the moral choices and prioritized moral principles of LLMs trained on English versus Chinese corpora using a dataset of 472 moral scenarios, and evaluating their alignment with individualistic versus collectivist cultural values.

Counterfactual gender substitution in moral scenarios (modifying pronouns, character genders, and gender-associated terms) to measure the consistency of the models' moral choices and variations in their prioritized ethical principles across male and female contexts.
